content.what_it_is: MATLAB paper-figure script (Zhang et al. 2022 idealized-beach / short-crested wave radiation stress study) that reads FUNWAVE-TVD binary station-averaged outputs and produces three publication figures. Reads from PlaneBeach_st_360_av_240 results ('st means start averaging, av means averaging interval', L7; 'use output number 2,3' L8). Grid m=960, n=480, dx=2.0 (L10-L14), coordinates shifted by xshift=-m*2, yshift=-n+20.0-318 (L19-L25) so x is negative offshore. Accumulators for 16 fields are zeroed (L29-L44). For numb=2:3 (L47) it cds to the results dir (L50) and reads binary single-precision (m n) arrays via fopen/fread('*single')/transpose for: eta (L53-L57), Hsig (L59-L64), etamean (L66-L71), umean (L73-L78), vmean (L80-L85), then the x-direction momentum budget terms DxSxx, DySxy, PgrdX, FRCX, DxUUH, DyUVH (L90-L131) and y-direction terms DySyy, DxSxy, PgrdY, FRCY, DyVVH, DxUVH (L135-L175), summing each. After the loop all fields are averaged by ncount (L179-L195), vorticity computed via curl (L198), and momentum residuals formed: Rx=DxSxx+DySxy+PgrdX+FRCX+DxUUH+DyUVH (L201) and Ry=DySyy+DxSxy+PgrdY+FRCY+DyVVH+DxUVH (L202). cds to the paper directory (L205). Profile indices: rows nn2=390 (anti node), nn1=370 (middle), nn3=350 (node) (L208-L210); columns mm1=950, mm2=900, mm3=800, mm4=625 (L212-L215) with corresponding physical coordinates (L217-L224). Figure 1 (L230-L345): 2x2 tiledlayout of eta (caxis [-0.9 1.9], L239-L240), Hsig contourf 0..3 (L279-L280), setup etam with custom level vector vb (L298-L300), and vorticity with quiver (sk=8, sc=50; L320-L324), each overlaid with the two X-transect lines and four Y-transect lines and labels X1/X2, Y1-Y4 (L248-L265); printed to plots/ideal_4_frame_4prof_<foldname>.eps/.jpg (L344-L345). Figure 3 (L348-L408): 4-row alongshore (y) momentum budget plots at columns mm1..mm4, each showing PgrdY, DySyy, DxSxy, DyVVH, DxUVH, FRCY and residual Ry with LaTeX legends (e.g. gH d(eta)/dy, dSyy/dy, dSxy/dx, dQQ/H/dy, dPQ/H/dx, tau_y; L366-L404), printed to plots/momentum_xy2_<foldname> (L407-L408). Figure 2 (L410-L474): 4-row cross-shore (x) budget plots — rows 1-2 the x-momentum terms at antinode nn2 and node nn3 (L429, L439), rows 3-4 the y-momentum terms at the same rows (L452, L463) — printed to plots/momentum_xy1_<foldname> (L473-L474). Ends with return (L476).
entities: x, y coordinate vectors L15-L16, shifted L24-L25
X, Y meshgrid L17, shifted L22-L23
nn2, nn1, nn3 row indices L208-L210
fig figure handles L230, L348, L410
cbar colorbar handles L271, L293, L314, L334

verbatim_spans.text: % in /PlaneBeach_st_360_av_240/ use output number 2,3, looks great to represent small sxx along node

legend('$gH\frac{\partial \bar{\eta}}{\partial y}$','$\frac{\partial Syy}{\partial y}$', '$ \frac{\partial Sxy}{\partial x}$','$\frac{\partial \bar{Q}\bar{Q}/H}{\partial y}$', '$\frac{\partial \bar{P}\bar{Q}/H}{\partial x}$','$\bar{\tau}_y$','Ry','fontsize',14,'interpreter','latex','Orientation','horizontal')

unresolved: the residuals Rx/Ry (L201-L202) sum all budget terms with plus signs; whether sign conventions of the model outputs make these true residuals (should be ~0) or net forcing cannot be verified without the model source
vbh=[0.0:1.0:3:0] (L278) is malformed (colon expression 3:0 is empty) but vbh is never used
yy2 (middle row nn1) is computed (L218) but all its plot lines are commented out; icount (L27) unused
binary reads assume FUNWAVE binary output format (m n) single precision with no header; byte order/format not verifiable from this file
figure 1 caption labels X1/X2 for rows and Y1-Y4 for columns while variables are named nn (rows) and mm (columns); fig numbering order in file is 1,3,2
eval-based cd (L50, L205) changes the working directory mid-script; plots/ paths at L344/L407/L473 are relative to fdir_curr
